當你開始用「大家都這樣」來決定自己怎麼走，你就把方向盤交給了別人。: When you start deciding your path by "everyone does it", you hand the steering wheel to someone else.
大家都這樣，不代表適合你。: Everyone doing it doesn't mean it suits you.
越貼近自己的人，越經得起一點孤單和誤解。: The closer you are to yourself, the better you can handle a little loneliness and being misunderstood.
想一件你正在做、但其實是「因為大家都這樣」的事。問問自己：如果沒有人看，我還會這: Think of something you're doing only because everyone does it. Ask yourself: if no one were watching, would I still do it this way?
